forms.label: Unsweetened, dry
forms.sourceNote: Cocoa, dry powder, unsweetened. Public domain. The record's own tablespoon portion (0.365 g/ml) is a packing density, not a true one — mostly air between the grains. Blended into a milkshake it disperses through the liquid rather than sitting as loose powder, so the density-classes.json 'dairy-whole' class stands in as a rough approximation of what the dispersed solids displace, marked estimated. Cocoa solids carry a small natural amount of caffeine alongside the more abundant theobromine.
